text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I can't believe today's the day!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Actually, I just got a call from my sisters. They said the whole family's cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want to give it my best and win for my own sake, but also, I really want to make my sisters proud…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Today's the day—I'm winning this one! Just you watch!
choice_data_list: Get out there and give it all you've got!
